states_or_flow: PLANNED | EXPECTED | LIVE_BORN_OR_FIRST_KNOWN | PREGNANCY_LOSS_RECORD | STILLBIRTH_RECORD | DECEASED | EXISTENCE_DISPUTED | ERRONEOUS_STATE_REVIEW
trigger_or_rule: Authorized activation event only for active live-horse identity
guards: Pregnancy loss and stillbirth remain preserved non-active outcomes
evidence: Activation, source, actor, effective and recorded times
prohibited_automatic_behavior: Planned or expected foal silently becoming active

trigger_or_rule: Verification, dispute, correction, supersession, or archive action
guards: Supporting states include pending verification, duplicate, merge, unmerge, and split correction review
evidence: Candidate IDs, canonical IDs, decisions, restrictions, lineage

states_or_flow: ASSERTED | IMPORTED | SOURCE_CONFIRMED | PROFESSIONALLY_VERIFIED | DISPUTED | RESTRICTED | SUPERSEDED | UNKNOWN
guards: Automated confidence alone cannot advance to professionally verified
evidence: Source owner, version, confidence basis, dispute and correction state
prohibited_automatic_behavior: Imported or AI-derived claim becoming verified truth

states_or_flow: Compatible time-bounded states including care, training, competition, breeding, rehabilitation, sale, transport, retirement, missing, stolen, memorialized, and archived
guards: Configuration changes do not rewrite historical meaning
evidence: State version, effective time, source, owning domain
prohibited_automatic_behavior: Single global status collapse or retroactive reinterpretation

states_or_flow: DRAFT -> INITIATED -> AUTHORITY_REVIEW -> EVIDENCE_REVIEW -> CONTINUITY_PREPARATION -> APPROVED_OR_DECLINED -> SCHEDULED -> EFFECTIVE -> DOWNSTREAM_RECONCILIATION -> COMPLETED
trigger_or_rule: Separate transfer case decisions and reconciliation
guards: Completion prohibited while critical obligations remain unresolved unless separately approved exception names risk owner
evidence: Parties, authority, evidence, restrictions, impact states, reconciliation

states_or_flow: OPEN -> EVIDENCE_GATHERING -> LIKELY_SAME | LIKELY_DISTINCT | INCONCLUSIVE -> MERGE_APPROVED_OR_REJECTED -> MERGED -> RECONCILED -> CLOSED
trigger_or_rule: Governed duplicate investigation and merge decision
guards: UNMERGE_REVIEW or SPLIT_CORRECTION_REVIEW may open after closure
evidence: All candidate IDs, source records, conflicts, restrictions, lineage and downstream reference map
prohibited_automatic_behavior: Automatic merge from weak match, AI, name, color, facility, photo, or vendor ID

trigger_or_rule: Projection invalidated when permission, restriction, source, policy, or watermark changes
guards: Verification discloses minimum safe status only
evidence: Generation time, policy, source versions, watermark, expiry, invalidation and external-copy limitation
prohibited_automatic_behavior: Claiming remote deletion of external copies

trigger_or_rule: Authorized archive basis, correction, claim, legal hold, retention, erroneous-state restoration, or memorial action
guards: Archive prevents ordinary mutation while preserving correction route
evidence: Archive basis, restriction, legal hold, retention and restoration evidence
prohibited_automatic_behavior: Deletion of identity/history or ordinary active mutation

states_or_flow: REQUESTED -> BLIND_MATCHING -> NO_MATCH | MEDIATION_REQUIRED | AUTHORIZED_HANDOFF -> RECONCILED -> CLOSED
trigger_or_rule: Purpose-bound blind match, mediated result, and current authority
guards: Do not expose other tenant, horse-record existence, protected facts, or canonical internal ID before authority permits handoff
evidence: Transfer token, limited evidence, mediation state, permission result, audit

states_or_flow: PENDING -> AUTHORIZED -> EFFECTIVE -> RECONCILED | REVERSED | CORRECTION_PENDING
trigger_or_rule: Each material transfer impact carries its own state and effective time
guards: Case completion does not retroactively make every impact effective at one time
evidence: Impact-specific relationship custody possession access care facility communication schedule financial and stewardship records
